no_reselection_guarantee: 2025 was never used to select the ensemble recipe (w=0.2 chosen in C from development evidence only; E executed the frozen recipe with no weight search, no stacker, no calibration). Individual-model 2025 behavior was known before V3.4 (documented statically in A); the 2025 ENSEMBLE evaluation did not exist until E executed the frozen recipe.

A.purpose: Ensemble landscape + frozen experiment contract; no fitting

B.purpose: Development grid evaluation + expanding-window stacker on D1/D2/D3

C.purpose: Controlled selection + robustness; exactly one recipe (w=0.2) or NO_ENSEMBLE

D.purpose: Final recipe freeze (machine-readable FIXED_CONVEX_BLEND w=0.2); immutable before E

E.purpose: Previously revealed 2025 out-of-time evaluation of the frozen recipe only
